compat.text: It can be used on many types of structures or elements for cementitious, metallic and epoxy resin binder substrates
compat.heading: DESCRIPTION

compat.text: Systems Standard Three Coat System: (DFT: from 600um - 800um) Primer: Sikafloor 160 or 161 + 1st Coat: Sikagard®-63 N + 2nd Coat : Sikagard®-63 N . Fibreglass Laminate System: (DFT: from 1000um - 1200um) Subject to Glass thickness Primer : Sikafloor 160, Fibreglass, Sikafloor 160 + 1st Coat: Sikagard®-63 N + 2nd Coat : Sikagard®-63 N . Sikagard EpoCem 720 System: (DFT: 1200um +) Subject to thickness of SikaGard EpoCem 720: Typically used on High Wear, Damaged or High moisture content substrate applications: SikaGard EpoCem 720 + 1st Coat: Sikagard®-63 N + 2nd Coat : Sikagard®- 63 N . Please refer to individual Product Data Sheets and consult the Sika Technical Department for specific Consumption Priming and Coverage Information pertaining to project requirements: Please see Important Considerations section at the bottom of this PDS
compat.heading: SYSTEM INFORMATION

compat.text: Do not apply Sikagard®-63 N on moist substrates.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not use to produce glass fibre reinforced linings.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Products must be cured before applying Sikagard®-63 N. Steel / aluminium Surfaces must be prepared mechanically using suitable abrasive blast cleaning, grinding, rotating wire brush or other suitable equipment to achieve a bright metal finish
compat.heading: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION

compat.text: Reference must be made to the preparation levels in the following standards if compliance is required: ISO EN 12944-4: level Sa 2 ½ NACE International Standard: SSPC-SP 10 “near white metal blast cleaned” EN 14879, part 1 Apply a suitable compatible primer on the prepared steel as soon as possible to prevent oxide development
compat.heading: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION

compat.text: Contact Sika Technical Services for additional Epoxy resin-based products Surfaces must be prepared by abrading using suitable equipment
compat.heading: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION

compat.text: General On high absorbent, non-cementitious based substrates a suitable primer must be used
compat.heading: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION

handling.label: Advice on protection against fire and explosion
handling.text: Normal measures for preventive fire protection.

handling.label: Advice on safe handling
handling.text: Avoid exceeding the given occupational exposure limits (see section 8). Do not get in eyes, on skin, or on clothing. For personal protection see section 8. Persons with a history of skin sensitisation problems or asthma, allergies, chronic or recurrent respiratory disease should not be employed in any process in which this mixture is being used. Smoking, eating and drinking should be prohibited in the application area. Provide sufficient air exchange and/or exhaust in work rooms. Follow standard hygiene measures when handling chemical products

handling.label: Hygiene measures
handling.text: Handle in accordance with good industrial hygiene and safety practice. When using do not eat or drink. When using do not smoke. Wash hands before breaks and at the end of workday.

respiratory.label: Respiratory protection
respiratory.text: In case of inadequate ventilation wear respiratory protection. Respirator selection must be based on known or anticipated exposure levels, the hazards of the product and the safe working limits of the selected respirator.

hands.label: Hand protection
hands.text: Chemical-resistant, impervious gloves complying with an approved standard should be worn at all times when handling chemical products if a risk assessment indicates this is necessary. Follow AS/NZS 1337.1 Recommended: Butyl rubber/nitrile rubber gloves. Contaminated gloves should be removed.

skin_body.label: Skin and body protection
skin_body.text: Protective clothing (e.g. safety shoes, long-sleeved working clothing, long trousers) Follow AS 2210:3 Rubber aprons

engineering_controls.label: Appropriate engineering controls
engineering_controls.text: Use adequate ventilation and/or engineering controls to prevent exposure to vapours.
